messages:
Jamie (Support): AcmePay ticket #12345 — customers are hitting tool/function_call failures. They report a 400 with message: \"Invalid tool arguments: JSON parse error: Unexpected token '\\'' at position 128\".

They pasted their payload (redacted):
```
POST /v1/responses
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood/assist-1\",
  \"input\": \"summarize account activity\",
  \"tool_calls\": [
    {
      \"tool\": \"lookup_transactions\",
      \"args\": '{\"account_id\": \"acc-123\", \"start\": \"2026-01-01\", \"end\": \"2026-02-01\", }'
    }
  ]
}
```

They say this used to work; started failing after a client SDK upgrade. Escalating — can eng take a look?

Ben (eng-runtime): On it. Two quick asks: 1) can you paste the exact raw body we receive at the edge (including any escape sequences) and 2) confirm SDK & runtime (customer says js-sdk@2.4.1). My hunch: args inside tool_calls are being passed as a JSON-encoded string with single quotes or trailing commas — we do json.parse(args) in the tool runner and that will blow up.

Jamie (Support): Pasting raw request we got from our proxy logs (sanitized):
```
{\"model\":\"redwood/assist-1\",\"input\":\"summarize account activity\",\"tool_calls\":[{\"tool\":\"lookup_transactions\",\"args\":\"{'account_id':'acc-123', 'start':'2026-01-01', 'end':'2026-02-01', }\"}]}
```
Edge response: 400 {\"error\":\"Invalid tool arguments: JSON parse error: Unexpected token '\\'' at position 22\"}

Carlos (sre): Is this failing during edge validation or in the tool-runner service? Looking at traces it seems to be parsed downstream in tool-runner (tokenizer/parser stack). Could be a client-side change or our body-unwrapping change that stopped normalizing quoting.

Ben (eng-runtime): Reproduced locally with the same payload. Node stacktrace snippet:
```
Error: Unexpected token '\\'' at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
    at parseToolArgs (/app/tool-runner/parse.js:47:15)
    at processToolCall (/app/tool-runner/runner.js:128:22)
    at async handleRequest (/app/tool-runner/server.js:79:13)
```
Root cause: the customer is embedding a JS-style object literal (single quotes + trailing comma) inside a JSON string. We call JSON.parse on that inner string without sanitizing. Previously some clients sent args as an object (not a string) or correctly double-quoted JSON. The new SDK seems to stringify with single quotes in their environment.

Ben (eng-runtime): Two mitigation paths:
- Short term (supportable): return a clearer 422 with guidance and avoid crashing the runner — i.e., catch JSON.parse errors and return a helpful hint plus the exact offending substring.
- Medium term: accept and try to tolerant-parse common mistakes (convert single quotes to double quotes, remove trailing commas) — but that introduces risk of silently accepting invalid input.

Alyssa (support-lead): Customer impact? AcmePay says all tool calls are failing for a subset of their calls (they're fallback-checking non-tool flows for now). It's blocking one production job but not site-wide. Can we provide a workaround they can apply in minutes?

Ben (eng-runtime): Workarounds to give them now: 1) send args as a JSON object instead of string: \"args\": {\"account_id\":\"acc-123\",\"start\":\"2026-01-01\",\"end\":\"2026-02-01\"} — we already support object form. 2) if their pipeline requires a string, ensure it's valid JSON with double quotes and no trailing comma. Example of valid body:
```
{\"model\":\"redwood/assist-1\",\"input\":\"...\",\"tool_calls\":[{\"tool\":\"lookup_transactions\",\"args\":\"{\\\"account_id\\\":\\\"acc-123\\\",\\\"start\\\":\\\"2026-01-01\\\",\\\"end\\\":\\\"2026-02-01\\\"}\"}]}
```
Or they can URL/base64 encode the inner JSON string and decode in their client before sending.

Jamie (Support): Passing these options to the customer now. They'll try switching to object form first.

Ben (eng-runtime): I'll open a small change to improve error message and prevent a 500/500-like behaviour. Plan: catch JSON.parse errors in parseToolArgs, return 422 with body like {error: 'tool args invalid JSON', hint: 'check quoting/trailing commas', sample_correct_args: '...'} . PR #1425 opened — link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/1425 . Will add unit tests for single-quote/trailing-comma detection but not auto-correct.

Carlos (sre): Can we canary this in us-west-2 edge + tool-runner pool? If it's just messaging change that's low risk. If Ben wants to add a tolerant parser we should gate with a feature flag and monitor.

Ben (eng-runtime): Agree. Canary set: tool-runner group b and edge us-west-2. ETA: PR->canary ~ 3 hours, full rollout after monitoring for 12h if no regressions.

Alyssa (support-lead): Cool. Jamie — provide customer with the quickfix steps + ETA and put them on a 2h follow-up. Escalation id INF-2026-0315-ACME.

Jamie (Support): Done. Customer acknowledged the object-form workaround and will try now. I'll update the ticket when they confirm. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Ben (eng-runtime): Follow-up notes for postmortem: 1) add clearer API docs about allowed `args` shapes (object or JSON-string with valid JSON), 2) SDK compatibility test that ensures serialization uses double quotes, 3) consider a linter rule in js-sdk to prevent single-quote serialization.

Alyssa (support-lead): Adding to backlog: DOC-45 (docs clarity), SDK-210 (js-sdk serialization test).

Jamie (Support): Customer confirmed switching to object form fixed the calls. Marking resolved for now — will reopen if anything else crops up. 

(incident-bot): Action logged: escalation INF-2026-0315-ACME created, severity: 2, assigned: Jamie (Support).
